text:
Ajay (Sales): FYI - Nimbus is lining up a 12-month commit. POC scheduled Tue. Traffic profile: peak ~4k RPS, baseline ~800 RPS, avg ~60 tokens/req, convo context up to 1k tokens. Need concrete reserved GPU suggestion, autoscale plan, and delta vs hosted pricing. Any red flags? @Maya @Devin

Maya (Solutions): Are peaks short bursts or sustained? p95/p99 numbers? streaming on/off? Is there heavy KV/prefix reuse?

Ajay (Sales): They say bursts are ~10s every 10min, sustained baseline ~800. p95 ~2k, p99 ~3.3k. Streaming enabled. Session flows show ~70% prefix reuse.

Devin (Platform Eng): With that profile caching helps a lot. Rough throughput guide: llama-2-70b-int8 on A100-80 gives ~250-350 p95 RPS/GPU with batching + KV reuse. H100 typically 1.5-2x. These numbers assume aggressive batching (20ms) and prewarmed KV. SLO matters a lot.

Alex (SRE): Confirm SLO that customer expects for p95? That will drive how much reserve we need vs autoscale slack.

Ajay (Sales): They want p95 <= 350ms, but we could push negotiation buffer to 400ms if necessary. Security asks: VPC + SOC2 checklist — already flagged.

Maya (Solutions): Draft recommendation: reserve 10 H100 (or ~14 A100-80GB) int8. Autoscale to 20 GPUs for spikes using burst credits. Prewarm: keep ~50 slots/GPU and seed KV. Also route fallback to a smaller quantized model for extreme tails. I'll write runbook and cost notes.

Devin (Platform Eng): Example autoscale config for POC:
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_gpus: 10
  max_gpus: 20
  scale_up_threshold_rps: 1800
  scale_down_threshold_rps: 1200
  scale_up_cooldown_s: 45
  scale_down_cooldown_s: 300
prewarm:
  slots_per_gpu: 50
  kv_prefill: true
  kv_prefill_window_s: 600
model:
  quantization: "int8"
  fallback_model: "llama-2-13b-quant"
```
And a prefilling curl we can give them: 
```
curl -X POST https://internal-prefill/api/v1/prefill \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PREFILL_TOKEN' \ 
  -d '{"session_samples_s3":"s3://nimbus-poc/samples.jsonl"}'
```

Maya (Solutions): Also recommend region fallback policy in case AZ capacity is exhausted, and a model-fallback path to save cost on long tails. Legal will ask for reserved term language and a run-rate cap.

Ajay (Sales): Can we ballpark monthly cost for 10 H100 reserved vs 14 A100-80? Also what's cold-start penalty if GPUs idle >30m?

Devin (Platform Eng): Ballpark (region-dependent): 10 H100 reserved ~$120k-180k/month; 14 A100-80GB slightly cheaper but same order. Cold-start without prewarm/KV seed can cause p95 1.2-1.8s. With prewarm + KV seed we should hit <400ms for most requests.

Alex (SRE): We'll add a circuit-breaker to fallback to hosted smaller model for extreme outliers to avoid queuing. Prewarm + KV seed + short batching should mitigate the spike latency.

Maya (Solutions): I'll assemble: POC runbook, prewarm + KV scripts, autoscale YAML, and answers for the security questionnaire.

Devin (Platform Eng): I'll run perf tests against sanitized traces and post measured p95/p99 and tokens-per-GPU by EOD tomorrow.

Ajay (Sales): Owners: Maya -> runbook + sec answers; Devin -> perf numbers + final config; Ajay -> get traces + legal handoff. Thanks team, I'll update after I get traces. :thumbsup:
